```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(htmltools)
  library(base64enc)
})

img_b64 <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("data:image/png;base64,%s", base64enc::base64encode(path))
}

make_html_tbl <- function(df) {
  hdr  <- paste0("<th>", colnames(df), "</th>", collapse = "")
  rows <- apply(df, 1, function(r) {
    paste0("<tr>", paste0("<td>", r, "</td>", collapse = ""), "</tr>")
  })
  paste0(
    '<table class="methods-tbl"><thead><tr>', hdr,
    "</tr></thead><tbody>", paste(rows, collapse = ""),
    "</tbody></table>"
  )
}

n_combos <- length(snapshot$result$details)
metric   <- snapshot$result$metric
method   <- snapshot$settings$method
conf_pct <- paste0(round(snapshot$settings$conf * 100), "%")
boot_n   <- snapshot$settings$boot_n
# Locale-independent English date (avoids Chinese/Japanese month names on non-English systems)
.months_en <- c("January","February","March","April","May","June",
                "July","August","September","October","November","December")
gen_date <- paste0(.months_en[as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m"))],
                   format(Sys.Date(), " %d, %Y"))
src_file <- if (!is.null(source_filename) && nchar(source_filename) > 0)
              htmltools::htmlEscape(source_filename) else "uploaded file"
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-pills a[data-toggle="tab"]').forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      var ul = a.closest("ul.nav-pills");
      var content = ul.nextElementSibling;
      ul.querySelectorAll(":scope > li").forEach(function(li){ li.classList.remove("active"); });
      a.parentElement.classList.add("active");
      content.querySelectorAll(":scope > .tab-pane").forEach(function(p){ p.classList.remove("active"); });
      var target = document.querySelector(a.getAttribute("href"));
      if (target) target.classList.add("active");
    });
  });
});
</script>
```

```{r combo-tabs, echo=FALSE}
combo_names <- names(snapshot$result$details)
safe_ids    <- paste0("tab-combo-", seq_along(combo_names))

nav_items <- paste0(
  mapply(function(nm, id, i) {
    paste0(
      '<li', if (i == 1L) ' class="active"' else '', '>',
      '<a href="#', id, '" data-toggle="tab">',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(nm), '</a></li>'
    )
  }, combo_names, safe_ids, seq_along(combo_names)),
  collapse = ""
)

pane_blocks <- mapply(function(nm, id, i) {
  detail  <- snapshot$result$details[[nm]]
  is_act  <- if (i == 1L) " active" else ""

  day_chip <- if (identical(detail$metric, "TGI")) {
    paste0('<span class="chip">analysis day <b>', snapshot$settings$selected_day,
           '</b></span>')
  } else {
    end <- snapshot$settings$end_day
    paste0('<span class="chip">AUC end day <b>',
           if (is.na(end)) "all data" else as.character(end), '</b></span>')
  }

  chips <- paste0(
    '<div class="chips">',
    '<span class="chip">metric <b>', detail$metric, '</b></span>',
    '<span class="chip">method <b>', method, '</b></span>',
    '<span class="chip">conf <b>', conf_pct, '</b></span>',
    day_chip,
    '</div>'
  )

  eff_df  <- as.data.frame(detail$efficacy) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))
  eff_tbl <- as.character(
    knitr::kable(eff_df, format = "html", table.attr = 'class="methods-tbl"')
  )

  syn_df  <- as_display_table(detail$synergy) |>
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 4)))
  syn_tbl <- as.character(
    knitr::kable(syn_df, format = "html", table.attr = 'class="methods-tbl"')
  )

  fig_src <- img_b64(detail$figure)
  fig_html <- if (!is.na(fig_src)) {
    paste0(
      '<div style="text-align:center;margin:1rem 0;">',
      '<img src="', fig_src, '" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;">',
      '</div>',
      '<div class="caption">Bootstrap distribution and synergy assessment for ',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(nm), '.</div>'
    )
  } else {
    '<p style="color:var(--warning);">Figure not available.</p>'
  }

  paste0(
    '<div class="tab-pane', is_act, '" id="', id, '">',
    chips,
    '<h3>Efficacy (', detail$metric, ')</h3>', eff_tbl,
    '<h3>Synergy Scores &amp; Bootstrap CI</h3>', syn_tbl,
    '<h3>Bootstrap Distribution Figure</h3>', fig_html,
    '</div>'
  )
}, combo_names, safe_ids, seq_along(combo_names), SIMPLIFY = TRUE)

htmltools::HTML(paste0(
  '<ul class="nav nav-pills" role="tablist">', nav_items, '</ul>',
  '<div class="tab-content">',
  paste(pane_blocks, collapse = ""),
  '</div>'
))
```

```{=html}
<section id="s4">
<h2 class="sec-title"><span class="sec-num">4</span>Conclusion</h2>
```

```{r conclusion, echo=FALSE}
verdict_blocks <- lapply(names(snapshot$result$details), function(nm) {
  detail <- snapshot$result$details[[nm]]

  p_syn <- tryCatch(
    min(detail$synergy[["p.val.Synergy"]], na.rm = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
  p_ant <- tryCatch(
    min(detail$synergy[["p.val.Antagonism"]], na.rm = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )

  verdict <- dplyr::case_when(
    !is.na(p_syn) & p_syn < 0.05 ~ "synergy",
    !is.na(p_ant) & p_ant < 0.05 ~ "antagonism",
    TRUE                          ~ "additive"
  )

  label    <- c(synergy = "SYNERGISTIC", antagonism = "ANTAGONISTIC",
                additive = "ADDITIVE")[[verdict]]
  fb_class <- c(synergy = "success", antagonism = "danger", additive = "info")[[verdict]]
  fb_icon  <- c(synergy = "✓", antagonism = "!", additive = "ⓘ")[[verdict]]

  p_syn_fmt <- if (!is.na(p_syn)) formatC(p_syn, format = "f", digits = 4) else "&mdash;"
  p_ant_fmt <- if (!is.na(p_ant)) formatC(p_ant, format = "f", digits = 4) else "&mdash;"

  desc <- switch(verdict,
    synergy = paste0(
      "The observed combination ", metric, " significantly exceeds the ",
      method, " expected additivity (p<sub>syn</sub> = ", p_syn_fmt,
      "). The two agents act synergistically in this model."
    ),
    antagonism = paste0(
      "The observed combination ", metric, " falls significantly below the ",
      method, " expected additivity (p<sub>ant</sub> = ", p_ant_fmt,
      "). The two agents act antagonistically in this model."
    ),
    additive = paste0(
      "No significant departure from ", method, " expected additivity was detected ",
      "(p<sub>syn</sub> = ", p_syn_fmt, ", p<sub>ant</sub> = ", p_ant_fmt,
      "). The combination effect is consistent with additivity."
    )
  )

  paste0(
    '<h3>', htmltools::htmlEscape(nm), '</h3>',
    '<div class="verdict-banner">',
    '<span class="verdict-badge ', verdict, '">', label, '</span>',
    '</div>',
    '<div class="finding-box ', fb_class, '">',
    '<div class="fb-icon">', fb_icon, '</div>',
    '<div><b>', htmltools::htmlEscape(nm), ':</b> ', desc, '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )
})

htmltools::HTML(paste(verdict_blocks, collapse = "\n"))
```
